chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Jumhūr, from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Al-Haytham ibn Wāqid, from Abī Yūsuf Al-Bazzāz, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام recited this verse:
So remember the favors of Allah.
He said: “Do you know what the favors of Allah are?” I said: “No.” He said: “It is the greatest of Allah’s blessings upon His creation, and it is our wilayah.”

key_terms.آلَاءَ اللَّهِ: the favors or great blessings of Allah mentioned in the verse
key_terms.أَعْظَمُ نِعَمِ اللَّهِ: the greatest blessing bestowed by Allah
key_terms.تَلَا: recited, referring to the Imam’s recitation of the verse
key_terms.وَلَايَتُنَا: our wilayah, the divinely ordained authority and guardianship of the Imams عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: What does “the favors of Allah” mean in this hadith from al-Kāfī?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase about remembering the favors of Allah by identifying those favors, in their greatest sense, as the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It presents wilayah as among the supreme divine blessings bestowed upon creation and offers a tafsir-centered theological teaching on the verse.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moallad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman, from Al Haysam Bin Waqid, from Abu Yusuf Al Bazzal who said,
[7:69] therefore remember the Favours of Allah, that you may be successful.
Heasws said: ‘Do you know what is the Favour of Allahazwj?’ I said, ‘No’. Heasws said: ‘It is the most Magnificent Bounty upon Hisazwj creatures, and it is ourasws Wilayah’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Jumhur from ‘Adallah ibn ’Abd al-Rahman from al-Haytham ibn Waqid from abu Yusuf al-Bazzaz who has said that
“Keep in mind the bounties of Allah. .” [7:69]

The Imams (a.s.) said, “Do you know what the bounties of Allah are?” I said, “No, I do not know.” He said, “It is the greatest of the bounties of Allah. It is to acknowledge the Divine authority that we possess.”
